records.name: Kuno Keepfree
records.biography_en: Kuno leaves his towel on anything the HyperNorm residents might otherwise share. The clothespin makes the claim look legally secured. He sorts neighbours into those who respect the arrangement and those who need an explanation. The Men in Black appreciate this distinction; Hunky and Dory have suggested reserving more. A dissonant card recently asked whom the empty space was helping. Kuno has begun keeping a second corner free for someone who is late.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The place is taken. Attendance was never part of the arrangement.

records.name: Irma Allbymyself
records.biography_en: Irma insists the umbrella is meant to bend that way. HyperNorm recognises the independent and the dependent, leaving very little room for wet weather. She used to report cards that complicated the distinction. The Men in Black liked the reports; Hunky and Dory offered a certificate of self-sufficiency. A neighbour repaired the handle without mentioning it. Irma has not thanked them, but now leaves their parcels somewhere dry.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: She needs no help. The relief is strictly precautionary.

records.name: Edgar Actually
records.biography_en: Egon carries a measuring tape because numbers make unsolicited advice look like a service. HyperNorm divides conversations into explaining and being explained to. The Men in Black keep him supplied with conclusions; Hunky and Dory admire his helpfulness from a safe distance. A contradictory card once asked whether he had heard the question. He now pauses occasionally. The neighbours are unsure whether this is progress or a technical fault.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: He knows the answer. A suitable question will turn up.

records.name: Vera Nevertheless
records.biography_en: Vera keeps a small wooden wedge for doors that HyperNorm says must remain firmly shut. She distinguishes between unnecessary conflict and necessary air. The Men in Black call that an untidy classification; Hunky and Dory would prefer a louder answer they could quote. A dissonant card gave her a third possibility: disagree without declaring an enemy. She has been practising on the landing, where several neighbours have started staying for the conversation.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The objection was quiet. It is still there.

records.name: Mr. Justthisonce
records.biography_en: Mr. Justthisonce issues small permissions in the HyperNorm stairwell. His blank ticket means that a reason has been considered, even when it has not been written down. The Men in Black request consistent refusals; Hunky and Dory request impressive totals. A difficult card has made him notice the people behind the requests. He still describes every favour as a one-off. The building has become surprisingly full of one-offs.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: It remains an exception. Like all the others.

records.name: Bodie Backagain
records.biography_en: Bodo has polished the borrowed spoon and tied a ribbon round the unresolved obligation. HyperNorm classes possessions as yours or somebody else's, so he prefers to finish the matter visibly. The Men in Black find the ceremony excessive; Hunky and Dory would like a photograph. A dissonant card suggested that the loan was simply friendly. Bodo is considering this. In the meantime he has offered to lend the spoon back.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The spoon has returned. Its significance will follow separately.
